entities.summary: Abbé Giovanni Maria Ortes was a Venetian composer, economist, mathematician, Camaldolese monk, and philosopher. Ortes was one of the more renowned pre-Smithian Italian economists. He is better known for his population predictions that preceded those of Malthus.
